thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: reserved-pool rsv-prod-2 util=98% queued=162 growth=+80m over 5m. throttling observed for tenants: @AcmeCorp, @GreenfieldPay. autoscaler: scale_up_failed (ceiling=12, requested=14)
Maria (oncall): looking now. paging Ajay. AcmeCorp on dedicated reserved contract — high customer impact.
Ajay (sre): I see the autoscaler logs: `error: rate limit exceeded when calling cloud-v2/scale` and `scale_request rejected: pool_ceiling_reached`. also kube events show repeated evictions on worker-*gpu nodes.
Sasha (runtime): noisy-session pattern from tenant GreenfieldPay — many small sessions with long KV cache warmups. they currently have 6 reserved GPUs in this pool.
Evelyn (cs): I'm joining the call and pinging account team. AcmeCorp is mid-demo, they reported latency spikes. sending them a note: "we're investigating, possible throttling, will update in 10m" :pray:
Maria (oncall): mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase pool ceiling (requires infra approval), 2) offload low-priority sessions to hosted fallback (works per routing policy), 3) evict noisy sessions for burst window. prefer 2+3 short term.
Ajay (sre): I'll try emergency route: increase fleet cap to 14 via cloud CLI, but cloud API is returning 429s. fallback: add temporary hosted fallback route for AcmeCorp only. Sasha, can runtime accept a variant mapping?
Sasha (runtime): yes, we have a compatible quantized variant in hosted catalog (q8_compat). I'll prepare a canary route to redirect traffic for AcmeCorp user-prefix. will need a short maintenance window message.
DevOps Bot: runbook trigger: `runbook:reserved-pool-overload-v2` invoked by Maria. Exec path: `/infra/scale-ops/emergency`
Ajay (sre): running: `cloudctl pools update rsv-prod-2 --ceiling 14 --reason "emergency: evictions + queued"` -> response: `HTTP 429: quota API rate limit`. retrying with backoff.
Maria (oncall): while Ajay retries, Sasha please start the routing change: `routes create redirect --from tenant:AcmeCorp --to hosted:q8_compat --ttl 600 --fallback-on-error`
Sasha (runtime): applied canary route 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m. initial 5% sent now. logs: `route-applied id=rt-3425 canary=5%`.
Maria (oncall): monitoring queue length and latencies.
(2m later)
Ajay (sre): cloud API accepted scale after 3rd retry: `ceiling=14`. started provisioning 2 extra reserved workers. Pod placement logs: `allocated gpu-nv-a-09, gpu-nv-a-10`
Sasha (runtime): workers joining pool, but KV cache miss rate spikes for sessions migrated to hosted variant. will warm caches for high-priority prefixes.
Evelyn (cs): AcmeCorp replied: "thanks - seeing improvement on latency for some calls, others still slow." They asked for ETA.
Maria (oncall): ETA for additional capacity ~4m for workers healthy; routing will continue to reduce pressure. we should also evict long-idle sessions from GreenfieldPay for 10m. Ajay, can you run eviction for sessions >30m idle?
Ajay (sre): running eviction script: `./tools/evict-sessions --pool rsv-prod-2 --tenant GreenfieldPay --idle-gt 1800` -> `evicted 42 sessions`
DevOps Bot: action logged: `evict-sessions by Ajay (sre) - 42 sessions - reason: noisy-neighbor mitigation`
Sasha (runtime): queue dropped from 162 -> 28 over 6m, outage risk reduced. host fallback increased requests handled to 38%.
Maria (oncall): marking incident as "partial mitigation". notifying infra for followup: need to review autoscaler ceiling logic and rate-limit retries.
Evelyn (cs): sending customer update: "We increased capacity and routed some traffic to a fallback model; we also evicted noisy sessions. Monitoring is green but we'll follow up with a post-incident report."
Ajay (sre): notes for postmortem: autoscaler should surface cloud API 429s to oncall earlier, implement jittered exponential backoff with circuit breaker, and consider ephemeral burst capacity for reserved pools.
Sasha (runtime): runtime change: add per-tenant session caps and KV prewarm hints for reserved tenants to avoid long-lived noisy sessions.
Maria (oncall): closing active paging; leaving this thread open for postmortem items. If we see queue >100 again, re-pager. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
